method: Deterministic keyword audit of scene-specific prompt text and image briefs. Identity/policy preambles are excluded. This is a triage signal, not a claim that repeated smiles are automatically wrong; visual QA remains required after generation.
acceptance_rule: A repeated expression is acceptable when multiple scene prompts genuinely require it. Regenerate only when expression contradicts scene meaning, appears copied from an identity reference, or collapses distinct concepts into the same camera-facing portrait.
